notes: DRAFT for C-STORY-g (spec: drafts/content/C-STORY-review.md). Deeper Bestiary text for every Tier 1-3 regular enemy (bestiary-plan.json) and named monster (named-monsters.json); Guardians are covered by story/guardian-arcs.json. Same idea as the enemy files' bestiary.lore, gathered in one file so no enemy file changes. kidLine: ages 6-9, 8-12 words. olderReaderLine: ages 12-14, unlocked at the entry's tier belt, at most 2 short sentences, never past that tier's mystery-ladder.json fact. Behaviour matches the data; no new technique or mechanics. Checked by tools/check-bestiary-lines.py.

entries.name: Swarmer
entries.kidLine: Swarmers zip around in groups. Clear them first, then breathe!
entries.olderReaderLine: They rush because they are scared of the dark. Every crack of light in these halls calms them a little.

entries.name: Brute
entries.kidLine: The Brute is big and slow, and gets tired after chasing.
entries.olderReaderLine: It chases until it runs out of breath, then stands there, puzzled. Even big things need a rest.

entries.name: Shield Guard
entries.kidLine: Shield Guard blocks small hits. A strong Strike breaks through!
entries.olderReaderLine: It still guards a door, though it can't remember whose. Some habits outlast the reason for them.

entries.name: Wick Wisp
entries.kidLine: A tiny candle flame that wobbles along and bumps into you.
entries.olderReaderLine: A small flame drifting from the broken light. It bumps into you as if it wants to be carried home.

entries.name: Dust Bunny
entries.kidLine: A fluffy dust ball that rolls at you, then sneezes. Achoo!
entries.olderReaderLine: Dust gathers where no one has swept in a long time. These halls were busy once, and could be again.

entries.name: Lantern Moth
entries.kidLine: Lantern Moths toss glowing pebbles. Step out of the circle!
entries.olderReaderLine: Moths fly toward light. These ones circle the halls, looking for a lamp that broke into pieces.

entries.name: Sleepy Sentry
entries.kidLine: A sleepy stone statue that yawns, then stomps. Dash away!
entries.olderReaderLine: It fell asleep on watch long ago. When the light comes back, it might wake up glad.

entries.name: Bouncy Bopper
entries.kidLine: Bouncy Bopper bonks with a soft foam staff. Staff up, get ready!
entries.olderReaderLine: Its staff was always padded, made for practice, not for hurting. The storm shook it, but it still wants to play.

entries.name: Buzzy Bee
entries.kidLine: Buzzy Bees zip in and out in groups of three or four.
entries.olderReaderLine: The storm scattered their hive, so they buzz at everyone. Bees settle when the flowers open again.

entries.name: Thorn Sprout
entries.kidLine: A grumpy little sprout that puffs its cheeks and spits seeds.
entries.olderReaderLine: It grew thorns after the storm, as if to keep the next one away. Under the grumpy face, it is still a seed.

entries.name: Shellback Snail
entries.kidLine: A slow snail that hides in its shell when things get busy.
entries.olderReaderLine: When too much happens at once, it hides. Nobody blames it; storms make everyone want a shell.

entries.name: Vine Sweeper
entries.kidLine: Vine Sweeper swings one long vine. Watch the stripes and dash!
entries.olderReaderLine: The vines were tangled by a storm that nobody chose. Untangled, they would climb toward the sun.

entries.name: Old Thumper
entries.kidLine: Old Thumper stamps two times before it swings. Watch its feet!
entries.olderReaderLine: The garden's oldest statue stamps like it is keeping time. It remembers mornings before the storm, and waits for one more.

entries.name: Zippy Zoom
entries.kidLine: Zippy Zoom leaves sparkles that show where it will zoom next.
entries.olderReaderLine: A garden light the storm spun around until it was dizzy. It was never trying to hide its path.

entries.name: Captain Clank
entries.kidLine: Captain Clank taps its shield three times, then attacks. Listen!
entries.olderReaderLine: It once guarded the garden gate for its friends. The storm wasn't its fault, and it can still find its way back.

entries.name: Spark Sprite
entries.kidLine: Tiny warm sparks blink, then dart around the big ovens.
entries.olderReaderLine: Sparks from a kitchen that never quite went cold. They hop between ovens, as if checking who is still coming.

entries.name: Dough Blob
entries.kidLine: A wobbly dough ball that splits into two little Doughlings!
entries.olderReaderLine: Bread dough rises and waits. This one has been waiting a long time for someone to bake for.

entries.name: Ladle Lobber
entries.kidLine: Ladle Lobber flings soft soup splats from the back. Step aside!
entries.olderReaderLine: It keeps serving soup to anyone who walks by. It never fills one bowl, as if saving it for someone.

entries.name: Rolling Pin
entries.kidLine: A giant rolling pin rolls down its lane. Dash away!
entries.olderReaderLine: It rolls the same lane over and over, like a cook getting supper ready for a full table.
